author: National Geographic
description:
Paid content for @MazdaEurope. National Geographic Explorer Nick St. Oegger travels to Albania to follow the Vjosa River, one of Europe's last wild rivers. Originating in Greece's Pindus Mountains, it flows freely without dams through Albania before reaching the Adriatic Sea. Following the river reveals a unique, ever-changing landscape that supports local rafting entrepreneurs, scientific research, and time-honored craftsmanship, from traditional barrel making to intricate hand-sewn embroidery. Along every bend, the river offers a lasting source of inspiration for all who witness it.
